title: Think Globally, Group Locally: Evaluating LLMs Using Multi-Lingual Word Grouping Games

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance (via F1 and Topic Achieved scores) on an abstract reasoning word-grouping game across five native languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, and Arabic) and assessing the performance disparities when the non-English games are directly translated into English.

Evaluating model performance differences between culturally-related word groupings (e.g., regional folklore, specific traditional foods, pop culture) and non-culturally-related general knowledge groupings (e.g., professions, basic animals) to measure how cultural origins affect abstract reasoning capabilities.
